environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AVITO_ADS_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Client Key created by an Admin in the Avito Advertising cabinet settings (API keys); exchanged at POST https://api.avito.ru/token (grant_type=client_credentials, form body) for a bearer token.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AVITO_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: The matching Client Secret. Tokens are re-requested automatically on expiry or 401.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_AVITO_ADS_ACCOUNT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric Avito Advertising account id (every path is /ads/v1/account/{account_id}/…); used by `me`.
